cohort: 151 cases of histopathologically proven placenta accreta delivered in five University of California hospitals
finding: Scheduled deliveries were associated with a later gestational age at delivery, lower blood loss, higher birth weight, and shorter postpartum and neonatal lengths of stay.
gest_age: Scheduled deliveries: 34.6 weeks, Unscheduled deliveries: 32.6 weeks
birth_weight: Scheduled deliveries: 2488 g, Unscheduled deliveries: 2010 g
